channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump to demand compensation for Tehran’s ‘conflicts’
item.description: President Donald Trump says he’ll demand compensation from Iran for people killed or wounded in the US war on Iran.

item.title: Iran hierarchy consolidation as IRGC veteran tapped for key security role
item.description: The office of the supreme leader has named a new security chief and established war commanders in influential roles.

item.title: Iran’s president says Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’
item.description: Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian says Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei had a message of “unity and cohesion”

item.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
item.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

item.title: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
item.description: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

item.title: 30 years later, a former gang member will stand trial for Tupac's murder
item.description: It’s been three decades since Tupac was killed, and since then, his reputation has only grown.
